description: Valid (invented): (1) an A4 offer on an App file answering a recorded arrival, opened by the person from the arrival's row (SD-3; R18-5); (2) an A15 offer composed from one WR a15_descriptor: a new revision of supports-adjust following rev-4, bound to the reviewed draft's bytes; (3) one A15 act over two library entries registered in place, composed from one WR a15_multi_descriptor (DECISION-L L-4; R21-3): 'entry:' strings, no prior revision, the plural wording; each entry bound to its own reviewed bytes. (4) AAC-v0.3 (pass 4, R23-18): an A16 'decide' offer on one decision package (an App file recorded as an act_request), showing its two alternatives with their consequences; no decline. The A16 instance carries non-ASCII text (ü, ≈, U+2028) in its alternatives' consequences, and its offerDigest is aac-offer-digest/0.1 over those characters as themselves (RV E1-R4).
